posts.caption:
One ramen word to remember: kaedama 🍜
At Hakata ramen shops that offer it, kaedama means an extra serving of noodles for your remaining broth. Keep some soup and check the menu for availability and price.

posts.title_ja: おでんのメニュー解説
posts.caption:
Meet oden: a warm yatai favorite 🏮
Ingredients simmer in dashi broth. Egg and daikon are common choices, but each stall has its own selection. The yellow paste on the side may be Japanese mustard—start with a little.

posts.title_ja: 屋台エリア3つの選び方
posts.caption:
Three yatai areas for your Fukuoka plans 🏮
Nakasu: riverside scenery and a lively atmosphere.
Tenjin: stalls around the central shopping and business district.
Nagahama: ramen heritage and a range of menus.
Check the official Fukuoka yatai map and each stall’s opening details before heading out. This reel is an area guide; the opening photo is general yatai footage.
Follow @yuhei.fukuoka for more local travel ideas. Which area sounds like your kind of night?
